item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is packed with reminders, and meals tend to get squeezed between them. Decide now when you'll eat, instead of grabbing whatever is nearby when you're stretched thin. Aim for real food at regular times, with protein in each meal, and don't skip the midday one. Eating steadily keeps your mood and patience level, which matters when the evening gets busy. Action: pick your next meal and set a time for it.
